The dental clinic is located inside Building A of Chulalongkorn 3 Hospital. The clinic isn't very large, with a separate waiting area from the air-conditioned main area. Patients can park in the hospital's parking garage and get their parking ticket stamped at the clinic's counter for free parking.

There were quite a few patients waiting inside, about eight ahead of me. Combined with the fact that there were only a few doctors available, the waiting time was very long, approximately two hours.

Overall, the clinic was relatively clean. The waiting area chairs were a bit small, and the air conditioning inside the clinic was quite warm. While the wait was long, the doctor provided good care during my visit.
